name: handoff
description: Write a handoff document at the end of the turn that crosses a context threshold, stage it for the next context, and resume after /clear. Auto-compact stays a safeguard only.

THRESHOLD.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
THRESHOLD.description: At the end of a turn whose context is at or above this, Claude writes the handoff and you are told to /clear. 0 = off.

LIVE_FROM.title: Live state from (tokens)
LIVE_FROM.description: From this context size on, Claude keeps a running handoff file updated at the end of turns. 0 = off.

LIVE_EVERY.title: Live state interval (tokens)
LIVE_EVERY.description: Re-update the running handoff only after the context grew by this many tokens.

MODE.title: Auto-compact safeguard mode
MODE.description: inject: let auto-compact run after staging a handoff. block: refuse proactive auto-compact and ask for /clear.

MODEL.title: Summarizer model
MODEL.description: Model for the nested claude -p that writes a handoff from the transcript when Claude did not write one itself.

STARTUP.title: Fresh-startup behaviour
STARTUP.description: ignore: a new session told to ignore another session's staged handoff. adopt: use it.

T3_AUTOCLEAR.title: T3 Code auto-clear (experimental)
T3_AUTOCLEAR.description: When the handoff is staged inside a T3 Code thread, wait for the turn to end, then send /clear and /handoff:resume to that thread via t3ctl.
